lines.en: label dormwarsfive3:
scene sky
Imani Imai slept well that night, but she had to do it alone. At least the second and third times.
The first time was in the arms of her best friend. It lasted for approximately three hours and nine minutes. It was the largest of all three blocks of sleep she’d get that night.
She’d drifted in and out, yes. But never for long enough to put any sizable dent in the regular six hours she’d always try to get before starting the next day.
Between blocks one and two — when she’d wake and find that her best friend was no longer beside her — she’d sigh and think to herself, “that makes sense.”
She never expected him to stay. She just wanted him to.
She wanted a lot of things, though. A car. A nicer apartment. A raise. An answer to at least one of several questions she had about some dialogue during a roleplay last night.
But she had learned throughout her life that the solution to most problems is usually just time.
So she’d worry about all of those things later.
And for now-
She’d be needed in at least one way.
: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!
scene poolcook1
: AND ALSO MOLLY EVEN THOUGH SHE’S NOT HERE!
: Ahh, but what if she is, Uta? What if she’s one of our millions of viewers tuning in from home?!
: Then she’s going to have a very bad time because our contract wasn’t renewed and this year’s Dorm Wars isn’t being broadcast at all!
scene poolcook2
: Then why are we holding microphones?! And why did you wait until right now to tell me that?!
: Because it wouldn’t be Dorm Wars if I didn’t get to yell really early in the morning and Makoto didn’t want to do it with me!
: I understand! I also struggle finding people to yell with early in the morning! But do you know what I don’t struggle with, Uta?!
: Sensei’s penis!
scene poolcook3
: Cooking!
: And also Sensei’s penis.
scene poolcook4
: I’m not going to comment on that. But what I will do instead is ask you to give us a breakdown of the current situation, Uta.
: Because, at least from what I understand, this contest was originally scheduled to take place on the beach instead of in the school’s pool room.
: That’s right, Ayane. We had a helicopter from the Tsukioka Foundation prepared to go and everything.
: But as it turns out, an unexpected “tidal disaster” has laid waste to the beach! And it won’t be fixed up for at least two months.
scene poolcook5
: A tidal disaster, you say?
: Right again. But I’m sure it won’t be the only disaster we talk about today as we’ve got one hell of a contest coming up, Ayane.
scene poolcook6
: In just a few minutes, the Dragon of Kumon-mi High will take on everyone’s second-best friend, Noriko Nakayama! And at least one of them is expected to fail miserably.
: Now, it is possible Yumi surprises us despite being the clear underdog in the competition. But we won’t know until we really get into things.
: Which, based on telepathic communications I am currently receiving, is right now! Take it away, Imani!
scene poolcook7
: Thanks, Uta. As you can see, I’m live with Yumi and Noriko — the first contestants of the fifth annual Dorm Wars!
: Who are you talking to? There’s nobody there.
: Sure as fuck better not be anybody there. You’ve already talked me into wearing this bullshit. I ain’t tryin’ to put myself on display.
scene poolcook8
: You should. You’re really hot and I want you to have more confidence in yourself.
: You’re also a member of the swim club, so I’m not really sure what you mean by “this bullshit.”
scene poolcook7
: But that doesn’t matter because we’ve got a game to play and you guys are going to be the ones playing it!
: Now, the rules are simple. The two of you have fifteen minutes to make the “perfect omelet.”
: How you interpret that is completely up to you — and you’re both encouraged to exercise your creativity in any way you can.
: How many fuckin’ ways can somebody interpret “perfect omelet?” It’s just fuckin’ eggs and...ain’t that literally all it is? Just eggs?
scene poolcook9
: Omelets have other stuff, Yumi.
: What the fuck is it called when it’s just eggs then?
: I believe that would be called “eggs.”
: You really are an underdog here, aren’t you?
scene poolcook10
: I never said I expected to win, okay?! Chika does all the fucking cooking! Or...did...all the fucking cooking. Shut up! I’m just here for the free food!
: She’s a growing girl. She needs to eat so she’ll grow up big and strong.
scene poolcook11
: You could stand to eat every once in a while too. Could see your fuckin’ ribs in the locker room ten minutes ago.
: Awww, she was looking at me in the locker room. We really are in love.
scene poolcook12
: Right! Well, assuming there are no other questions, why don’t we round up your partners and begin the contest?!
scene poolcook13
: Partner?
: Did you not even read the email? Both teams get a partner from their floor to serve as an omelet advisor.
: I have an email address? What is it?
: If you manage to win here, it’s going to be the upset of the century.
: It’s just an omelet. Why would we need an advisor in the first place?
: Obviously because of people like Yumi who don’t seem to even understand what an omelet is.
: Don’t matter to me as long as I can eat it.
scene black
: Works for me! And I’m sure it would work for our viewers too if we had any!
: We’ll have some later! My friends are coming back for Death Ball! They’re going to watch from the roof though so they don’t accidentally die.
: If they do, it will just mean the game was successful.
: Praise be to the ball of death!
: Contestants! On your marks!
: Get set...
: EGG TIME MADNESS!
scene poolcook14
: Right off the bat, Yumi reaches for the bell peppers! Could it be that she has already learned the ways of the omelet?!
: Okay. Must be doin’ somethin’ right if this is apparently the way of the omelet.
: The fuck am I supposed to do with these things, though?
: Uh-oh! Sounds like Yumi should have checked her emails! An advisor would sure come in handy right now, wouldn’t they?
scene poolcook15
: Blondie! Give me some fuckin’ advice! Ain’t nobody else from the first floor here right now!
: Yeah, the turnout for the opening contest is really low this year. I hope everybody else checked their email and didn’t ride Touka’s helicopter into the tidal disaster.
: Imani, am I allowed to help Yumi? Or-
: Unfortunately not, Ayane. The contract you signed upon agreeing to be a commentator prohibits you from helping either of the contestants.
: Help me anyway! The punishment can’t be that bad!
: The punishment is death.
: Blondie! Kill yourself to help me! Which one of these colors tastes better?!
scene poolcook16
: Wow. Yumi’s even more hopeless in the kitchen than I would have imagined.
: Focus, Pink Psion of the Palace of Pinkerton.
scene poolcook17
: Sorry, are you talking to me?
: I see no other pink. Now heed these words as they are the most important you will ever hear. I hold in my hands the key to the perfect omelet.
: This, Psion...
: This is an egg.
: That’s it? That’s the advice?
: I have learned through experience that no one ever listens when I provide cooking advice, so I have decided to dumb it down to levels somewhat inconceivable.
: You may now ask me two questions about eggs.
: I don’t have any questions, Tsuneyo. I know how to make an omelet.
scene poolcook18
: Wow. My new methods work quite flawlessly. Perhaps this is how I should have been teaching all along?
: Noriko! Hi.
: Seeing as you have the time and aren’t currently fighting an internal battle about which bell pepper to use in an omelet, can you tell us a little about your strategy today?
: I don’t really have one.
: Can you come up with one then? Because it’s kind of hard to commentate on a competition where neither girl is doing anything.
scene poolcook19
: We’re only like thirty seconds in. And besides, I try not to use eggs if I don’t literally have to.
: In what situation would one literally have to use eggs?
: Reproduction.

: Reproduction and this contest, Noriko! This is the easiest win possible! You’re on my team! Just throw an egg on the grill at this rate and you'll have the competition in the bag. And also the grill.
: Why do we even have grills? Who cooks an omelet on a barbecue grill?
: I asked the same question when Geoffrey was dropping them off but he had to go save a princess from a burning building before he was able to answer.
: Cook, woman! Yumi is still choosing a pepper!
scene poolcook20
: Fuck! Why is cooking so hard?!
: Still?! Yumi, just choose one!
: No! This is the fuckin’ blobfish all over again! I bet these things are only here as a trick and that usin’ ‘em just gets our points docked!
: Then put them down!
scene poolcook21
: Okay! Then what?!
: Oh my fucking God. Hold on.
: Noriko! What are you-
scene poolcook22
: Use the green one. I like them more. They’re essentially the same exact thing as the red ones, just a little less ripe so you get an earthier, grassy taste with them.
: Uh...th...thanks?
: What’s this?! Is Noriko Yumi’s omelet advisor now?! Imani! Check the rules! Do we have to kill her?!
: Negative, Ayane! We’ve never seen anything like this before! Who could have ever predicted that one floor would help the other?!
: Me because Noriko’s too fucking nice! Noriko! Get back over here and make an omelet before we lose!
scene poolcook23
: No! I’m on Yumi’s team now! Go Yumi!
: Uhh...as much as I appreciate the help, you really ain’t gotta take the fall for me. I’ll just fuckin’ use both of ’em with some eggs and, like...I don’t know...milk?
scene poolcook24
: It’s true that milk can make eggs fluffier, sure. But did you know that it might also contain pus from mastitis — an infection of the cow’s udders?
: Ew. Don’t ruin milk for me, please.
: I can ruin a lot of things for you. I’m just not going to because I believe forcing one’s ideals upon another is a very rude thing to do.
: So you’ll just...subtly and sneakily ruin them then.
scene poolcook25
: Maybe every once in a while.
: Noriko, go back to your table. I know you’re too nice to not help me, but you’re fuckin’ over nine other girls who are tryin’ to win right now.
: But you need me the most, Yumi.
: Only cause I ain’t got the faintest fuckin’ idea of what I’m doin’ over here.
scene poolcook26
: I’m not talking about cooking.
: I...ain’t sure what you’re talkin’ about then.
: I’m not really sure either. I just feel like you could use a friend right now. So if my floor has to lose a point over it, oh well. Let’s make an omelet together.
: I don’t want to do any of the egg stuff, though. I’ll cut the vegetables.
: Uh-oh! It looks like Yumi’s in shock due to Noriko’s sudden but expected kindness!
: Only she would walk away from a free win! This martyr complex can’t escape even the culinary world! Is there nothing sacred to her besides compassion?!
: Do you love me yet? Or do I need to keep trying?
: I kind of hate you.
: Really? Why?
: Because you never fuckin’ leave me alone and it’s irritating as hell.
: So the same reasons you “hate” Sensei?
: Yumi, you’ve been holding those peppers for like five minutes straight. It’s time to put them down.
: I don’t think I can move my hands. They’re locked up. These peppers are a part of me now.
scene poolcook27
: Attention, world. I have completed the pink one’s omelet for her. The second floor can thank me later, seeing as most of them are not currently-
: BZZZZT! Omelet advisors are not allowed to do the cooking! That’s a technical foul against floor two!
: Tch! If only there was an omelet advisor advisor.
scene black
: Aaaand gimme that!
: Wha- don’t fuckin’ touch me! The fuck you think you’re doin?!
: What?! You said your hands were stuck! I’m just giving you a little help.
: Then why the fuck are you still holding onto one?!
: Oh, that’s just because I love you.
: Fucking leave me alone! Jesus!
scene poolcook28
: Oooookay! Well, now that the competition has come to a close and the mystery judge we pulled off the street has tasted the only omelet that was finished today...
: It is time for her to weigh in. On one omelet.
scene poolcook29
: A single omelet.
: That’s it.
: Because Noriko does not understand loyalty.
: I think I understand loyalty too well! It’s a major factor holding me back from the greatness I know I am capable of.
: Well I sure wish I could have seen some of that today!
: You did! You saw my loyalty to Yumi. I would give my life for her.
: I often wish you would.
scene poolcook30
: So, Nao-chan! You’ve shown up to a few Dorm Wars thingies now. And I know you can’t speak but, thankfully, there’s not much reason to as today’s victor is pretty obvious.
: So why don’t you go ahead and show all of our make-believe viewers at home the winner of the first Heaven & Hell competition?
scene poolcook31
: The real winner, please.
scene poolcook32
scene poolcook33
: Welp! There you have it, folks. Noriko’s kindness has finally damned us all.
: We’re down by one point, Uta. Kirin’s next and she’ll make up for it, don’t worry.
scene poolcook34
: Well, I sure hope so! Because we’ve got a ton of competitions left today!
: And if the second floor is playing from behind the whole time, I’m going to need to take some of Io’s anxiety medication to combat the darkness growing within me!
: Can you let go of me now? The thing is over.
: I’m never letting go of you for as long as I live. That’s just how loyal I am.
: Up next — Dungeons & Divas! A one on one battle of normies gone nerdy! Chika! Kirin! Which one will top?!
scene poolcook35
: Ah! Uhh...come out on top! That’s...that’s what I meant to say.
: Chika 100%%. Kirin couldn’t top to save her life.
scene poolcook36
: Yes! My thoughts exact-
scene poolcook37
: I mean no! Not my thoughts! Go away, stupid Noriko!
scene black
: But not you, imaginary viewer at home! Because we’ve got a ton left to show you!
: But not without changing into more appropriate clothes first!
: Ayane! The sponsors please!
: Kumon-mi High’s fifth annual Dorm Wars is brought to you in part by the Tsukioka Foundation, the Produce Delivery Administration, and Koi Cafe!
